image.Description: Scene, as in column stimulus of data/stimulus_order.tsv; the 120 analysed images.

preview_geometric_mean_ms.Description: Geometric mean across participants of the image's preview-trial detection latencies (exponential of the mean log latency). Detection latency: onset of the last fixation of the trial (the one that landed on the face) relative to search-display onset. Fixations beginning within 100 ms of onset are discarded, timeout trials are dropped, and in the face detection task the stimuli in config.EXCLUDE_STIMULI are excluded.

no_preview_geometric_mean_ms.Description: Geometric mean across participants of the image's no-preview-trial detection latencies (exponential of the mean log latency). Detection latency: onset of the last fixation of the trial (the one that landed on the face) relative to search-display onset. Fixations beginning within 100 ms of onset are discarded, timeout trials are dropped, and in the face detection task the stimuli in config.EXCLUDE_STIMULI are excluded.
